provenance: Hand-curated by the Sieve maintainers from each advisory's description and the upstream fix. Every symbol is verified to exist in the installed package source before it is used; a symbol that does not exist is reported as not found, never assumed. These labels are also the ground truth of the AI-extraction golden dataset.

entries.rationale: FullLoader (the default of yaml.load in 5.x) can construct arbitrary Python objects; the fix in 5.4 restricted FullConstructor.
python/object/new tag handled by FullLoader allows code execution when loading untrusted YAML with full_load or FullLoader.
HMACAlgorithm.prepare_key did not reject all public-key formats, allowing algorithm confusion when the caller lets the token choose the algorithm.
rebuild_auth kept the Authorization header on an https-to-http redirect to the same host.
rebuild_proxies re-attached Proxy-Authorization to requests redirected to HTTPS destinations.
Connections pooled after a verify=False request were reused for later verified requests; the fix replaced get_connection.
get_netrc_auth parsed the URL host incorrectly, so a crafted URL could receive credentials meant for another host.
PoolManager.urlopen forwarded the Authorization header on cross-host redirects.
PoolManager.urlopen did not strip the Cookie header on cross-origin redirects.
Proxy-Authorization was not stripped by PoolManager.urlopen on cross-origin redirects.
ssl_wrap_socket loaded the system's default CA certificates even when explicit ca_certs were given.
The regular expression in urlize (the |urlize filter) has catastrophic backtracking.
The |xmlattr filter accepted keys containing spaces, allowing attribute injection.
The |xmlattr filter accepted keys containing /, >, or =, allowing attribute injection.
str.format in the sandbox could reach unsafe attributes. Only relevant when SandboxedEnvironment renders untrusted templates.
Indirect references to str.format escaped the sandbox. Only relevant to SandboxedEnvironment.
The |attr filter could select str.format and escape the sandbox. Only relevant to SandboxedEnvironment.
JSON request bodies with an unexpected encoding raised errors that led to denial of service; fixed by encoding detection in flask.json.loads.
save_session did not set Vary: Cookie when the session was refreshed, so caching proxies could share another user's cookie.
The interactive debugger could be driven from an attacker-controlled domain. Only relevant when the debugger is enabled.
The debugger PIN was derived from guessable values inside containers.
safe_join did not reject Windows drive-relative paths, enabling traversal on Windows.
Nameless cookies were parsed as if they had a name, bypassing __Host- prefix protection.
Specially crafted long inputs to idna.encode took quadratic time.
The bundled CA store trusted TrustCor roots. Any use of the bundle (certifi.where) is affected.
The bundled CA store trusted e-Tugra roots. Any use of the bundle (certifi.where) is affected.
